text:
Introduction
The first draft initiated by eng. Nashwa Hessain Mohamed, 
 tested by eng. Atef Mohamed Mahmoud Abdel Rahman, accepted by general director 
 eng. Samir Mohamed, approved by eng. Ahmed Shelabi Faisal: Head sector of EHV 
 Cairo zone EETC.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Voltage transformer must be isolated and grounded .
Secondary main circuit breaker must be isolated .
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment
Multimeter, air blower, rags
Voltage indicator.
Work to be Carried Out
Check PT foundation to ensure it is in correct vertical
 position.
Examine the surface of the porcelain for scratchs, chips,
 flash over burns, and cracks.
Check and retighten 
 if necessary all mounting bolts of voltage transformer.
Check the oil level on the oil level gauge.
Check for oil leaks.
Check and clean terminals box inside and out.
Check the terminals box gasket, repair if required.
Clean voltage transformer porcelain.
The main earting connection must be check and retighten if
 necessary.
